data.exact_reserve_text: The gross claims development table on page 18 shows a strengthening of GBP 29,924k for the 2016 underwriting year (from GBP 97,252k to GBP 127,176k), a strengthening of GBP 15,969k for the 2017 underwriting year (from GBP 262,651k to GBP 278,620k), and a strengthening of GBP 25,312k for the 2018 underwriting year (from GBP 288,461k to GBP 313,773k), totaling a gross strengthening of GBP 71,205k for 2018 and prior years. The Statement of changes in members' balances on page 5 notes that the 2017 underwriting year closed and the final amount settled by members was GBP 37,423k, representing a net loss.
